authority: server owns membership, request status, donation eligibility, cooldown and balances; no success is fabricated locally

sampleValues.nature: review fixtures only; bind to existing configuration

proposedEconomy.recipientOverflow: retain unclaimed entitlement; never discard rewards or silently exceed caps
proposedEconomy.approvalScope: UI behavior proposal; actual balance/storage policy must match the host server

requestAction.submitting: disable repeat action; show Requesting; keep button geometry
requestAction.success: create own request card from returned requestId and expiresAt; start cooldown from server time
requestAction.failure: restore action and show localized error; do not consume cooldown locally
requestAction.cooldown: show server-derived countdown; refresh on resume/reconnect; do not reset from device time
requestAction.existingOpenRequest: scroll to own request instead of posting duplicate
requestAction.notMember: return to Teams access after confirmed membership loss

donationAction.eligible: show Help on another member request
donationAction.success: replace button with check and Sent; update received count from response; play short heart transfer
donationAction.failure: show error and Retry; do not increment request or debit/give balance
donationAction.duplicate: server enforces unique donor per request; repeated response is idempotent
donationAction.fullOrExpired: refresh card and show complete/ended state; no optimistic grant
donationAction.concurrentLastSlot: server resolves eligibility; refresh count after conflict

receiving.partial: show server-confirmed received/required; no Collect until server marks claimable
receiving.ready: five filled hearts in example, green Collect
receiving.collecting: disable repeat action; keep pending UI while server transaction completes
receiving.success: atomically credit granted amount and mark request claimed; show Collected; update existing lives/bank widget
receiving.failure: keep entitlement ready; show retry; do not play successful credit animation
receiving.fullLives: show Lives full / Collect later; preserve entitlement until capacity is available or approved bank accepts it
receiving.partialCapacity: claim at most allowed amount or bank remainder using server policy; never mark entire request claimed if entitlement remains

messages.fetch: cursor-based history; show older-load spinner in feed; preserve scroll anchor
messages.send: use client-generated operation id; pending bubble until acknowledged; no duplicate on retry
messages.failed: keep draft or failed bubble with explicit Retry
messages.newWhileReadingHistory: show New messages pill; do not jump scroll
messages.timestamps: format in user locale from authoritative UTC timestamps
messages.systemEvents: deduplicate by eventId; use localized templates and safe plain text
messages.report: use existing message moderation/report flow; long-press or overflow action; not sent automatically

offline: keep cached history visible, show connection strip, disable request/help/collect; preserve unsent draft. Revalidate when connected.
empty: team badge, story-aligned welcoming copy, enabled Message action if connected
loading: keep header/navigation stable; content loading state only
mail: existing destination only; unread count is authoritative; no new reward inbox backend in this package
serverIntegrationNotes: Reuse existing authentication and team services.
Do not trust client-provided balances or cooldown timestamps.
Bind all operations to stable request/message/operation IDs.
On app restart, recover unacknowledged operations from server state before retry.
